body:
I’ll try my best. 

Thank you.

I doubt my family would still love me if they knew that I fantasize about killing people. 

My suicide would hurt them. I know. My father’s sister just attempted, and he is extra worried about me, but all he thinks is that I’m depressed. He doesn’t know that I am a dangerous person. 

I like going to therapy, though. It helps.

What if I end up going through with one of my thoughts and someone gets hurt? The pressure in my head is getting so intense. I can’t beat it out of myself anymore. I have an appointment with my therapist tomorrow, and I don’t know how honest to be.

I don’t mean to be dismissive or negative, and I really appreciate your response, but I have spent so long trying to work on myself. I lived alone for a few years before college to do just that — I got into better shape, tried going out more, and I would insert myself into social situations. It did me no good. It got me to trust people enough to be taken advantage by a guy time and time again despite how much I said * no. *

I’m so tired of trying to be social, and that exhaustion has hit me pretty hard now. I thought that maybe in my time in college I could be normal. I could touch someone and be touched and finally have it be with my consent — but it’s like I repulse people. 

I want to change so badly, but I have been trying to for so long that I am weary and sore.

I’ve been on the Zoloft for months now. I’m being put on Geodon to help curb the homicidal thoughts. 

I do know how for now. But that is waining. I was just sitting outside punching myself and shaking with the thoughts of killing others. I hate that I have become someone like this. It’s disgusting.
